cand.title: VI International Congress of Dominican Society of Physics (VI CI-SoDoFi 2025)
cand.excerpt: Residential multi-day scientific congress accommodation, meetings and catering for researchers, faculty, students and speakers. Plausible hotel demand (inferred, not verified): Visiting staff lodging and meeting needs are a hypothesis until a travel/meetings owner confirms patterns.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Best first contact: Dr. Inna Samson, general coordinator and named hotel-arrangements contact. Second commercial operations contact: Prof. Cristian J. Casilla Barclay, organizing committee member and named payments contact. Dr. Melvin Arias Polanco is organizing committee president and a relevant executive escalation; Dr. Juan M. López Encarnación coordinates the scientific committee/communications and can route enquiries. These are verified organizer roles, not evidence of sole contracting authority.
findings.futureEdition: Verified upcoming: VIII International Congress of the Dominican Physical Society (VIII CI-SoDoFi 2027), January 12–15, 2027, Punta Cana, Dominican Republic. The organizer-authored first call explicitly states these activity dates and venue; the event website agrees. The seed VI edition ran January 14–18, 2025 and is expired. No 2028 edition announcement was located; January 2028 must not be presented as confirmed.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied 620-room all-inclusive hotel profile: this is a plausible guestroom-led scientific residential group, not a generic transient-meeting lead. Historical programs explicitly include hotel check-in, a welcome dinner for hotel guests and concurrent scientific sessions in Punta Cana A/B. Wyndham Alltra offers three customizable indoor venues and up to 300 conference / 200 banquet guests, making a future edition potentially compatible only after confirming total attendance, simultaneous room layouts, poster space, AV and academic/student budgets. Resort format is demonstrated by the actual hosts; guestrooms and room nights cannot be quantified from conference papers or speaker counts.
findings.venueCommitments: The 2027 first call explicitly names Hotel Catalonia Bávaro Beach, Golf & Casino Resort as EVENT VENUE. The event site publishes hotel occupancy prices. This is an announced incumbent host, not merely a preferred-hotel listing. Contract execution, exclusivity, room allocation and remaining availability are not public in the reviewed material.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified history: 2020 Coral Costa Caribe Resort & Spa, Juan Dolio; 2021 abstract book labels Santo Domingo, but hotel/physical-versus-virtual status is unresolved; 2022 virtual sessions January 17–18 and in-person sessions January 19–21 at Hotel Iberostar Dominicana, Punta Cana; 2023–2026 Catalonia Bávaro Beach, Punta Cana; 2027 announced again at Catalonia. This establishes venue changes in the history, followed by repeated Catalonia hosting—not a demonstrated regular destination-rotation policy.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Published organizer pathway: Dr. Inna Samson, denergy@sodofi.org, is expressly assigned hotel arrangements. Prof. Cristian Casilla, contabilidad@sodofi.org, handles payments; Dr. Juan López, info@sodofi.org, handles communications and invitation letters. The 2027 site quotes USD 291.20 single, USD 182.00 double, USD 154.70 triple and USD 91.00 children aged 7–12, all per person per night, not per room. These rates and an identified arrangements contact evidence organized accommodation, not a published room block or open procurement. No hotel-sourcing RFP, alternative-hotel call or overflow need was located.
findings.organizationStructure: Sociedad Dominicana de Física (SoDoFi) is a nonprofit scientific society, founded June 3, 1979 and incorporated by Presidential Decree 1439 on January 16, 1980. It owns/organizes the congress through its named committee. Catalonia is the host venue, not the association. No external PCO, DMC or accommodation agency is identified in the reviewed congress materials; this does not prove none is involved.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Catalonia is the announced 2027 competing hotel and the documented host for 2023–2026. Inference: this incumbent continuity and published lodging rates materially limit displacement. There is no sourced evidence of sellout, capacity failure, overflow, dissatisfaction or a competitive tender. The reviewed sources do not establish a Cap Cana/La Romana opportunity. Alltra must not count Catalonia bookings as its own demand.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Inna Samson at denergy@sodofi.org first, referencing her published hotel-arrangements remit and acknowledging Catalonia as the announced January 2027 host. Ask whether any genuine unplaced lodging exists; otherwise request the next uncommitted edition, incumbent agreement horizon, venue-selection timetable, budget, pickup history and two-track meeting/poster requirements. Include Cristian Casilla at contabilidad@sodofi.org for payment/procurement routing, without assuming either is sole signatory. Offer an Alltra site inspection and a comparable all-inclusive per-person proposal only after fit and an uncommitted sourcing cycle are confirmed. Do not send an unsolicited 2027 replacement-block quote as though sourcing were open.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The VI 2025 seed is closed by elapsed dates and should not qualify as an upcoming lead. The successor VIII 2027 edition falls inside the requested horizon, but its announced venue is Catalonia. Participant hotel availability and any right to source elsewhere remain unknown. Do not classify 2027 as open sourcing or forecast Alltra room nights; no verified overflow path exists.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: retain as recurring-series relationship development, not immediate 2027 capture. Numbered January editions are evidenced for 2020–2027, but no 2028 dates or host were located and no annual or rotation policy should be promised. A later-edition alternative-resort proposal is commercially plausible because historical venues changed; prolonged Catalonia tenure is a real barrier. Any 2028 opportunity is conditional on organizer confirmation.
